name: Tsuburaya Fields Holdings Inc.
summary: Tsuburaya Fields Holdings Inc. engages in the content-related businesses in Japan. The company plans, develops, manufactures, sells, and maintains /pachislot (PS) machines. It is also involved in the planning and development of software for PS machines; management and operation of fitness gyms; information and mechatronics equipment; provision of information services through the Internet; and planning and production of computer graphics, etc, as well as offers pachinko hall facilities. In addition, the company engages in the planning and production of movie/TV; trading card business; and planning, production, and sale of character goods. Further, it manages, leases, and trades in real estate…
